name: Hotel multi-outlet POS with fiscal printers
about: Building one point-of-sale system for every outlet of a hotel - reception, cafe, bar, restaurant, golf course, spa - running on tablets or PCs at the till, with fiscal printers, card payment terminals, kitchen order routing, table bills, room charges and accommodation board plans (room only, bed and breakfast, half board, full board). Four stages: core platform, orders and payments, hotel integration, then reporting and rollout to every outlet. Hardware for 12 stations is under capex, in USD. The top of the tree is split into stages (milestones), and every stage has the same four phases: Analysis, Implementation, Tests and Deployment, so each stage ends with something released and signed off. Every task is estimated in man-days on a T-shirt scale (XS 0.5, S 1, M 3, L 5, XL 10); parents roll up from the tasks below them.

items.name: M1: Core platform

Card terminal integration options and certification
Hotel PMS integration: guest lookup, room charges, folios
Architecture: central server, offline mode per outlet, sync
Data model: outlets, stations, menus, orders, bills, payments, shifts
Roles: waiter, bartender, cashier, receptionist, manager
Implementation
Backend skeleton, CI/CD and environments
Outlets, stations and device registration
Users, PIN login and roles
Product catalog: items, modifiers, tax rates, price per outlet
Menu builder per outlet and time of day
Offline-first till app for tablets and PCs
Central sync and conflict handling
Tests
Unit and integration tests
Offline and reconnect tests
Deployment
Test environment at the hotel
Pilot hardware: 2 stations, fiscal printer, card terminal
Stage review and sign-off
M2: Orders, bills and payments
Analysis

Bill rules: split, merge, transfer, service charge, tips
Implementation

Table map and open tabs for restaurant and bar
Split and merge bills, move orders between tables
Order routing to kitchen and bar printers or screens
Fiscal printer drivers and fiscal receipts
Card terminal integration: payments, refunds, tips
Cash and mixed payments, change
Discounts, vouchers and service charge
Shift open and close, cash count, X and Z reports
Tests
Fiscal printer tests on every supported model
Card terminal certification tests
End to end: order to fiscal receipt in every outlet
Peak load test: 50 stations at once
Deployment
Pilot in the cafe
Stage review and sign-off
M3: Hotel integration: rooms and board plans
Analysis
Board plans: room only, bed and breakfast, half board, full board, all-inclusive
Room charge rules and credit limits
Package entitlements: breakfast included, golf green fees, spa credit
Implementation
PMS integration: guest lookup and posting charges to the room
Board plans and the items each one includes
Charge to room with guest signature
Package entitlements used up at outlets

Golf: tee times and green fees as products
Invoices for companies with tax ID

PMS integration tests in the vendor sandbox
Check-out reconciliation: every outlet to the folio
Board plan scenarios
Deployment
Rollout to restaurant and bar
Rollout to reception and golf course

Analysis

Implementation

Accounting export

Deployment
Tablets and POS PCs: 12 stations
Fiscal printers: 6 outlets
Card payment terminals: 8
Kitchen and bar printers, cash drawers
Wi-Fi and network for outlets, golf clubhouse included
Fiscal device registration with the tax authority
Staff training per outlet
Go-live with on-site support
Hypercare: four weeks
Final acceptance
